intent.zh: 学校往往是起点。导演一再追问在哪里上学、学到了什么、对教育怎么看，想看教育在多大程度上延续了出身，又在多大程度上改变了它。
intent.en: School is the starting line. The questions keep returning to where they studied, what it gave them and what they think of it — to see how far education carried their origins forward, or changed them.

intent.zh: 从 7 岁“长大想做什么”到后来的职业和失业，工作问题把童年的设想和成年的现实放在一起对照。
intent.en: From “what do you want to be?” at seven to later careers and job losses, questions about work set childhood plans against adult reality.

intent.zh: Apted 说，这部片是想“长远地观察英国社会”，“阶级制度需要被踹上一脚”；当初选孩子，看重的不是性格，而是把他们当作“各自所属阶级的某种象征”。多年后他仍然认为，“出身的阴影依然笼罩着人们能有哪些选择”。
intent.en: Apted said the series was “an attempt to do a long view of English society” and that “the class system needed a kick up the backside”; the children were chosen “as sort of symbols of the class they came from”. Decades on, he felt “the shadow of your birth still hangs over what people’s options are.”

intent.zh: 从孩子们怎么看男孩女孩，到恋爱、结婚、离婚，这类问题记录了每个人的亲密关系怎样展开。
intent.en: From what the children thought of boys and girls to courtship, marriage and divorce, these questions follow how each person’s close relationships unfolded.

intent.zh: 当他们自己做了父母，导演会问：希望孩子拥有你当年的东西吗？这把“出身”的问题延伸到了下一代。
intent.en: Once they became parents, the questions turn to the next generation — do you want for your children what you had? — carrying the question of origins forward.

intent.zh: 住在哪里、搬去哪里、离开英国还是留下，这类问题把人生轨迹落在具体的地方上。
intent.en: Where they live, where they moved, whether they left Britain or stayed — these questions ground each life in a place.

intent.zh: “你幸福吗？”“有什么遗憾？”这类问题请每个人回头评价自己的人生。
intent.en: “Are you happy?” “Any regrets?” These questions ask each person to look back and judge their own life.

intent.zh: 随着年龄增长，问题转向疾病、失去亲人和对死亡的看法。
intent.en: As they age, the questions turn to illness, bereavement and how they think about death.

intent.zh: 宗教、政治和做人的原则：这类问题想了解是什么在支撑每个人的选择。
intent.en: Religion, politics and personal principles: these questions ask what lies behind each person’s choices.

intent.zh: 每隔七年被拍一次是什么感受？这类问题让参与者评价这部片子本身，以及它对自己人生的影响。
intent.en: What is it like to be filmed every seven years? These questions ask the participants about the series itself and what it did to their lives.

intent.zh: 在最早的几部里，问题围绕游戏、朋友和日常生活，记录孩子们原本的样子。
intent.en: In the early films the questions are about games, friends and daily life — a record of who the children were.

intent.zh: 他们自己的父母怎样、家里发生过什么：这类问题追溯每个人成长的家庭，也就是“出身”最直接的那一部分。
intent.en: What their own parents were like and what happened at home: these questions trace the family each person grew up in — the most direct part of where they came from.

intent.zh: 工作和家庭之外，他们喜欢做什么：音乐、运动、园艺、绘画。这类问题让人看到每个人自己选择的生活。
intent.en: Beyond work and family, what they enjoy — music, sport, gardening, painting. These questions show the life each person chooses for themselves.

intent.zh: Apted 说，这部片是想“长远地观察英国社会”，“我们追踪了社会上的重大事件和变化”。所以他也会问每个人怎么看政府、移民、种族和脱欧。
intent.en: Apted described the series as “an attempt to do a long view of English society”: “We tracked major events and progress in society.” So he also asks what each person thinks of government, immigration, race and Brexit.
